title: 3 Team Division
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 4 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 3 \leq N \leq 100; A_i \in \lbrace 1, 2, 3 \rbrace; For each x \in \lbrace 1, 2, 3 \rbrace, there exists some i with A_i = x.; 1 \leq B_i; \displaystyle\sum_{i = 1}^{N} B_i \leq 1500; All input values are integers.
